headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 26, 2026**
article:
The Washington Nationals secured a 6-3 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Cade Cavalli earning the win after 6.0 innings of work. James Wood led the Nationals' offense with 3 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their team's availability. The New York Mets' Luis Robert Jr. has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a lumbar spine disc herniation. The Athletics' Aaron Civale and Denzel Clarke are also out with injuries, Civale suffering from right shoulder tendinitis and Clarke with a mid foot bone bruise in his right foot.

The Colorado Rockies made a roster move ahead of a series, trading left-handed pitcher Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals in exchange for cash. The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for future considerations and international bonus pool money. The Cincinnati Reds traded RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley, while the Tampa Bay Rays traded LHP Joe Rock to the Chicago White Sox for 3B Oliver Dunn.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Guardians 6-3**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 6-3 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Cade Cavalli earning the win after 6.0 innings of work. James Wood led the Nationals' offense with 3 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rays Fall to Orioles in 6-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays suffered a 6-1 defeat at the hands of the Baltimore Orioles. Shane Baz pitched 7.0 innings for the Rays, striking out 9 batters and allowing 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Angels Soar Past Tigers in 10-6 Thriller**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels secured a 10-6 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Vaughn Grissom leading the charge at the plate. Grissom's impressive performance included 3 hits, 1 home run, and 6 RBIs, while José Fermin earned the win with 1.1 scoreless innings of relief.

top_news.title: **Pirates Rout Cubs 12-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Chicago Cubs, winning 12-1 behind a strong performance from their offense. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Pirates' charge with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Luis Robert Jr. Shifts to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: New York Mets center fielder Luis Robert Jr. has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a lumbar spine disc herniation.

top_news.title: **Rockies Make Roster Move Ahead of Series**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies traded left-handed pitcher Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals in exchange for cash on May 25, 2026.
